报告元数据.主营业务: 机械密封、干气密封、密封辅助（控制）系统、旋转喷射泵、橡胶塑料密封件、特种阀门及导向环的研发、设计、生产与制造
报告元数据.企业名称: 中密控股股份有限公司（Sinoseal Holding Co., Ltd.）
报告元数据.报告页码/章节: 第1-77页，涵盖环境、社会、治理及附录各章节

环保投资.原文: In 2025, SNS invested RMB2.16 million in environmental protection. No major sudden environmental incidents, violations of environmental protection regulations, or administrative penalties occurred.（第19页）

环境管理体系.值: 截至2025年底，SNS、Sun Seals、UTEC、NDIV和KS GmbH均已获得ISO 14001环境管理体系认证。
环境管理体系.原文: By the end of 2025, SNS, Sun Seals, UTEC, NDIV, and KS GmbH have obtained ISO 14001 environmental management system certification.（第18页）

碳管理体系建设.值: 公司参照ISO 50001标准完善能源管理体系，报告期内完成ISO 50001能源管理体系年度外部审核，并将该标准纳入综合管理体系；同时系统识别气候风险，制定防洪、防暑等专项应急预案。
碳管理体系建设.原文: The Company strictly adheres to laws and regulations such as the Energy Conservation Law of the People's Republic of China and improves energy management system with reference to standards like ISO 50001. During the reporting period, the Company successfully completed annual external audit for the ISO 50001 energy management system and has integrated the standard into comprehensive management system.（第20页）

碳总量.原文: Total Scope 1 + 2 emissions: 4,560.48 tCO₂e (2025), 4,200.19 (2024), 3,804.69 (2023)（第73页 ESG Performance Indicators）

碳排放强度.原文: Scope 1 + 2 emission intensity: 2.58 tCO₂e/RMB million in revenue (2025), 2.68 (2024), 2.78 (2023)（第73页 ESG Performance Indicators）

范围一排放.原文: Total Scope 1 emissions: 157.26 tCO₂e (2025), 161.22 (2024), 166.86 (2023)（第73页 ESG Performance Indicators）

范围二排放.原文: Total Scope 2 emissions: 4,403.22 tCO₂e (2025), 4,038.97 (2024), 3,637.83 (2023)（第73页 ESG Performance Indicators）

能效提升对比度.值: 直接能源消费强度由2024年0.06吨标准煤/百万元营收降至2025年0.05吨标准煤/百万元营收；间接能源消费强度由2024年0.59吨标准煤/百万元营收升至2025年0.61吨标准煤/百万元营收。可再生能源电力占比由2024年6.64%提升至2025年13.32%。
能效提升对比度.原文: Direct energy consumption intensity: 0.05 (2025), 0.06 (2024), 0.07 (2023) tonnes of standard coal equivalent/RMB million in revenue; Indirect energy consumption intensity: 0.61 (2025), 0.59 (2024), 0.61 (2023) tonnes of standard coal equivalent/RMB million in revenue; Percentage of renewable electricity in total electricity consumption: 13.32% (2025), 6.64% (2024), 8.09% (2023)（第73页）

能源类型和强度.值: 主要能源为电力，辅以天然气和液化石油气；2025年直接能源消费总量84.52吨标准煤，间接能源消费总量1,079.76吨标准煤；直接能源消费强度0.05吨标准煤/百万元营收，间接能源消费强度0.61吨标准煤/百万元营收。
能源类型和强度.原文: The Company's energy consumption in production and operations is primarily electricity, supplemented by natural gas and liquefied gas.（第24页）；Total direct energy consumption: 84.52 tonnes of standard coal equivalent; Total indirect energy consumption: 1,079.76 tonnes of standard coal equivalent; Direct energy consumption intensity: 0.05 tonnes of standard coal equivalent/RMB million in revenue; Indirect energy consumption intensity: 0.61 tonnes of standard coal equivalent/RMB million in revenue（第73页）

能耗同比变化.值: 直接能源消费总量由2024年88.33吨标准煤降至2025年84.52吨标准煤，同比下降约4.31%；间接能源消费总量由2024年925.13吨标准煤增至2025年1,079.76吨标准煤，同比上升约16.71%。
能耗同比变化.原文: Total direct energy consumption: 84.52 (2025), 88.33 (2024), 92.15 (2023) tonnes of standard coal equivalent; Total indirect energy consumption: 1,079.76 (2025), 925.13 (2024), 833.26 (2023) tonnes of standard coal equivalent（第73页）

节能目标与改造情况.值: SNS及所有控股子公司设定“每万元产值电耗不超过2024年水平”的目标，除UTEC略超目标外，其余公司均达成目标。2025年SNS在节能降碳措施上投入3,713,761.84元。节能改造包括：Sunny Seal改造压缩空气管道并更换阀门减少气体泄漏；UTEC定制新4米立式车床替换旧设备、购置新4.5米烘箱；Sunny Seal建成2MW屋顶分布式光伏项目；UTEC采购光伏绿电，KS GmbH采购100%碳中和天然气。
节能目标与改造情况.原文: In 2025, SNS and all holding subsidiaries set a target for 'electricity consumption per RMB10,000 of output value not to exceed the 2024 level'. With the exception of UTEC, which slightly exceeded the target, all other companies achieved this goal.（第25页）；SNS invested RMB 3,713,761.84 in energy conservation and emission reduction measures（第25页）

供应商碳培训及考核情况.值: 公司通过组织专项供应商培训活动，就供应商产品尺寸控制、外观标准和现场管理提供指导，确保质量要求统一；报告期内业务道德培训（供应商）覆盖率为100%。但未提及针对供应商的碳管理专项培训及考核。
供应商碳培训及考核情况.原文: The Company also extends its quality training to supply chain partners. By organising special supplier training events, it provides guidance on suppliers' product dimensional control, appearance standards, and on-site management to ensure quality requirements are unified.（第34页）；Coverage rate of business ethics training (suppliers): 100% (2025), 100% (2024), 100% (2023)（第72页）

包装减量及回收情况.值: 2025年消耗木质包装材料106,096.58平方米、塑料包装材料15公吨。公司实施包装减量措施：按客户要求集中包装货物以减少单位产品包装材料用量；回收外包装箱用于采购件；采用定制可重复使用运输托盘替代一次性包装材料。
包装减量及回收情况.原文: In 2025, SNS consumed 106,096.58 square meters of wooden packaging materials and 15 metric tonnes of plastic packaging materials.（第28页）；Implement centralized packaging of goods according to customer requirements to reduce the amount of packaging material used per unit of product. Recycle the outer packaging boxes of purchased parts for reuse. Adopt customized, reusable transport pallets in place of disposable packaging materials to reduce packaging material consumption.（第27页）

循环经济链塑造.值: 公司推进材料减量与循环利用：通过工艺优化、材料替代和耗材重复使用提升资源利用效率；实施无纸化生产、运输耗材回收、材料替代等措施；2025年回收/再利用废弃物价值496.43吨；Sun Seals通过油水分离器回收切削液，使冷却液使用寿命翻倍；NDIV通过浮球装置、水泵和三段式油水分离过滤罐实现试压水回用；Sun Seals建设维护清洗废水处理系统实现回收再利用。
循环经济链塑造.原文: The Company focuses on material reduction and circulation by promoting the conservation and recycling of raw materials, packaging materials, and office and process consumables across procurement, production, packaging, and after-sales processes.（第27页）；Value of recycled/reused waste: 496.43 tonnes (2025), 108 (2024), 60 (2023)（第73页）

供应链碳风险传导影响评估.值: 公司将气候变化因素纳入供应商管理考量，制定科学的供应商备份和物料库存计划，增强供应链韧性；通过推进国产替代、开发本地供应商、对关键材料实施“双供应商”策略，确保供应链可控性和韧性。但未披露具体的碳风险传导影响评估。
供应链碳风险传导影响评估.原文: Incorporate considerations for climate change factors into supplier management, develop scientific supplier backup and material inventory plans, and enhance supply chain resilience.（第22页）；By promoting domestic substitution, developing local suppliers, and implementing a 'dual-supplier' strategy for key materials, we ensure the controllability and resilience of our supply chain.（第59页）

交易所ESG披露指引符合性.原文: This Report has been prepared with reference to documents including the Self-Regulatory Guidelines No. 17 for Companies Listed on Shenzhen Stock Exchange—Sustainability Report (For Trial Implementation), the Self-Regulatory Guidance No. 3 for Companies Listed on the ChiNext Market of Shenzhen Stock Exchange—Preparation of Sustainability Report, and the Global Reporting Initiative Sustainability Reporting Standards (GRI Standards) (2021 Edition).（第3页）
